workload.note: First time since his 2019 rookie year he failed to reach 1,000 yards, due to a quad strain and ankle sprain (Commanders.com, 2026-08-05).

contract.note: Signed a 3-year, $97M deal after his Pro Bowl/All-Pro 2024 season (per Commanders.com, 2026-08-05). Note: an earlier CBS Sports article from 2025-07-27 described him in the 'final year' of a prior 3-year, $68.3M deal during a camp holdout that preceded this new extension.

scheme.note: First year as OC in 2026 (entering 3rd season with org, 1st calling plays); Commanders have two new coordinators for 2026, neither of whom had called plays at the pro level before this season (SI, 2026-07-28).

competition.name: Stefon Diggs
competition.note: Listed atop the 'WR2' grouping on the Commanders' first unofficial 2026 depth chart (2026-08-10), ahead of Treylon Burks and Antonio Williams.

notes: McLaurin remains the clear WR1 on the Commanders' 2026 unofficial depth chart (2026-08-10).

camp.quote: My body feels great. I'm clocking 22 mph, not missing any days.

timeline.note: Not listed on Commanders injury report as of Sep 1, 2026; appears healthy for Week 1. Sleeper API oddly returns injury_status 'Active' (no actual injury description found).

timeline.role: OC David Blough had promised ~10 targets/gm; Week 1 fell short, prompting scheme-adjustment talk
timeline.note: Week 1 vs PHI: 4 targets, 2 rec, 14 yds

timeline.role: LWR1 on Washington depth chart per Sleeper; not on Commanders injury report (healthy)
timeline.note: Week 2 vs Cowboys (loss 20-37): 2 rec, 50 yds, 0 TD. Week 1 vs Eagles: 2 rec, 14 yds, 0 TD. Target counts not shown on available page; receptions light both weeks.
